hot_threads.topic: 2024 robotic vacuum cleaner selection and brand comparison
hot_threads.thread_summary: The original post presents a comprehensive 2024 robotic vacuum cleaner comparison video covering 5 major brands and 17 models, analyzing features like sweeping, mopping, edge cleaning, navigation, obstacle avoidance, base stations, and smart features. The community reaction reveals significant consumer frustration: multiple users report poor after-sales service experiences with brands like Ecovacs and Dreame, with complaints about products breaking quickly and difficult warranty processes. Several comments express exhaustion with the need to extensively research products due to marketing hype, fake reviews, and incremental feature releases designed to maximize profits. Users share personal experiences of product failures and difficult returns, while others note that all brands seem to have after-sales service complaints. The discussion extends beyond robotic vacuums to broader consumer challenges in China, including similar issues in healthcare. Many users indicate they now rely on personal research and friend recommendations rather than influencer reviews due to distrust of marketing and perceived lack of transparency.
